lines.text: Paul says the one who judges others has no excuse, because he does the same things.
Because of a hard and unrepentant heart, the judge is storing up sorrow against himself for the day of wrath.
God will give eternal life to those who persevere in doing good, but wrath and anger to the self-seeking.
Trouble comes for evildoers and glory for those who do good, first for the Jew, then for the Greek, since God shows no favoritism.
God will judge men's secrets through the prophets, as Paul's gospel proclaims.
